user.title: Legal notice
user.description:
Version 3 · effective from 30 September 2026

**1. What Nokturno is**

Nokturno is an add-on for Kodi and Home Assistant. It is a player and search tool for your own storage (for example WebDAV) and for the storage services and catalogues of third parties that you enable in the settings (WebShare, Sosáč, HellSpy, Sledujteto, FastShare / Sdilej.cz, Přehraj.to, CZtor, Luna). It searches for subtitles on OpenSubtitles. You decide which sources you use. Nokturno is free, without ads and without paid features.

**2. How searching works**

Nokturno asks the enabled sources for a title's name or identifier and shows the files they return. The files are stored on the servers of those services, were uploaded by their users, and your player downloads them directly from there. Nokturno does not host or distribute any film, series or other work.

Nokturno does not verify the legal status of individual files. It does not check who uploaded a file or whether they had the rightsholder's consent. A file appearing in the results does not mean you may legally play it.

Searching runs on your device with your accounts. The Nokturno server does not search for files. It provides title information (catalogues, TV guide, recommendations), keys for the interfaces of title-information and subtitle services, and synchronisation between your devices.

**3. What you may and may not do**

- Use Nokturno only for content you have the right to – your own recordings, freely licensed works, and content you hold a licence or other legal title to. Playing or downloading a copyrighted work without the rightsholder's consent is prohibited.
- Do not use Nokturno to infringe the rights of others or to distribute content you have no right to.
- When you connect a third-party service, its terms apply to you as well. Nokturno gives you no rights to the content of those services.
- Do not share your source accounts with other people unless the source's terms allow it.
- Do not send automated requests to the Nokturno server, do not get around limits or blocks, and do not offer access through Nokturno as a paid service.

**4. Reporting content and blocking**

Only the service that stores a file can actually delete it. We therefore recommend that rightsholders report it there directly (contacts are at the end).

You can also report it to us. What a notice must contain and how we handle it is described at nokturno.stream/abuse; send it to abuse@nokturno.stream. We reply to a complete notice and block the title or file in Nokturno's results within 48 hours. The block reaches the add-on with a list from the server, older versions after they are updated.

**5. No warranty and limitation of liability**

We provide Nokturno "as is", free of charge and with no warranty of functionality, availability or of what third-party sources contain. You are responsible for what you play and download with Nokturno.

To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for damage arising from using Nokturno or from being unable to use it, for the content, availability and terms of third-party services, or for how you use Nokturno. Liability that cannot be excluded by law is not affected.

We may restrict or end access to the server at any time, especially if these terms are breached.

**6. Personal data**

Which data Nokturno sends, why, how long we keep it and how to ask for its deletion is described at nokturno.stream/privacy.

**7. Governing law**

These terms are governed by the law of the Czech Republic. If you are a consumer habitually resident in another country, you keep the protection the law of that country gives you.

**8. Changes to these terms**

Every version has a number and a date. We will announce significant changes in the add-on, and Kodi and Home Assistant will ask for your consent again.

**9. Contacts**

- reporting content: abuse@nokturno.stream (procedure at nokturno.stream/abuse)
- personal data: privacy@nokturno.stream
- everything else: kontakt@nokturno.stream
- help with the add-on: the help pages and Discord (not for legal matters)

**Reporting directly to the source**

- WebShare – abuse@webshare.cz
- Sosáč / Streamuj.tv – streamuj.tv/advertise (DMCA)
- HellSpy – hellspy.to/contact
- Sledujteto – sledujteto.cz/nahlasit-nelegalni-soubor
- FastShare – fastshare.cz/abuse
- Sdilej.cz – abuse@sdilej.cz
- Přehraj.to – prehrajto.cz/nahlasit-nelegalni-soubor
- CZtor – contact via cztor.com/kontakt
- OpenSubtitles – copyright@opensubtitles.org (DMCA)

cztor.description: On a phone or computer open **{url}**, sign in and enter the PIN **{pin}**. Then press Submit here. The account password is never entered into Home Assistant.

prehravani.title: Playback
prehravani.description: Playback target and the rules for picking a stream.

data.hide_dv_only: Hide Dolby Vision without a fallback layer (profile 5)

data_description.kodi_entity: The players the card offers to choose from. A service call that names no entity starts playback on all of them.
data_description.pref_lang: Streams with this audio language are listed first. For Czech, Slovak subtitles count as well, and the other way round. “—” = language is not taken into account.
data_description.pref_surround: Surround 5.1 and above ranks above stereo. Affects ordering only; stereo streams stay in the list.
data_description.hide_sd: Streams below 720p are left out of the list. With older titles this can leave the list empty.
data_description.hide_3d: 3D files (by name: 3D, H-SBS, Half-OU, MVC, or by the MKV header) are never shown, not even when there is no other stream.
data_description.hide_dv: Dolby Vision files are never shown, not even when there is no other stream. Detected from the file header (for the first streams in the list), otherwise by name: DV, DoVi, Dolby Vision.
data_description.hide_dv_only: Only streams that a TV without Dolby Vision shows in green and purple. Detected from the file header, otherwise only by the P5 mark in the name.
data_description.hide_hdr: HDR files, including Dolby Vision, are never shown, not even when there is no other stream. Detected from the file header (for the first streams in the list), otherwise by name: HDR, HDR10, HDR10+, DV, DoVi, Dolby Vision.
data_description.hide_av1: For players that cannot play the AV1 codec (older Shield, Apple TV).
data_description.sort_streams: How streams are ordered when language and audio are the same.
data_description.max_bitrate_mbps: Upper limit on stream bitrate. 0 = unlimited.
data_description.multi_play: Applies only when more than one player is set. “Ask” opens a list of players when Play is tapped; “first one listed” starts playback right away on the first player and a long press on the button opens the list.

webshare.title: WebShare
webshare.description: Sign-in to WebShare. If you turn the source off, the credentials stay stored.

data.sub_warn_days: Warn N days before WebShare subscription expires (0 = off)

data_description.ws_password: Stored as a hash, not as the password. The end of the subscription is detected automatically and reported by the source-status sensor.
data_description.sub_warn_days: How many days before the WebShare subscription ends to warn. 0 = no warning.

sosac.title: Sosáč
sosac.description: Sosáč searches and plays through a streamuj.tv account. If you turn the source off, the credentials stay stored.

data_description.streamuj_username: A streamuj.tv account. Without it Sosáč finds titles but cannot play them.

sledujteto.title: Sledujteto
sledujteto.description: A Sledujteto.cz account. If you turn the source off, the credentials stay stored.

data_description.st_email: A Sledujteto.cz account. Search works without Premium, playback does not.

fastshare.title: FastShare / Sdilej.cz
fastshare.description: A FastShare.cz or Sdilej.cz account. If you turn the source off, the credentials stay stored.

data.fs_password: Password (playback uses your credit or unlimited plan)

data_description.fs_provider: Sdilej.cz has the same files as FastShare, only the account is separate. Choose the site where you have your account and credit.
data_description.fs_username: A FastShare.cz or Sdilej.cz account, as set in “account from”. Playback is charged against credit or an unlimited plan.

prehrajto.title: Přehraj.to
prehrajto.description: Works without an account, a Premium account adds paging and the original file. If you turn the source off, the credentials stay stored.

data_description.pt_enabled: Přehraj.to works without an account: the first page of results and a transcoded 1080p file. A Premium account adds paging and the original file.
data_description.pt_email: Optional. With a Přehraj.to Premium account you get paging and the original file. Přehraj.to counts every sign-in as a device, so Nokturno signs in only once every few hours.

luna.title: Luna
luna.description: Luna on your device – Home Assistant add-on, TV box, computer or NAS. If you turn the source off, the credentials stay stored.

data_description.luna_url: Address of the device running Luna, with port 7126 – the Home Assistant host for the HA add-on, or the IP address of the TV box, computer or NAS running Luna. The whole install address from the /setup page can be pasted; the token is read from it.

uloziste1.title: Storage 1 (WebDAV)
uloziste1.description: Nokturno plays mainly from your own storage (WebDAV – NAS, Nextcloud). Fill in the folder address, or skip this step and add the storage later in the integration options.

data_description.dav1_url: Address of the folder with films and shows on a NAS or Nextcloud. It must be reachable from Home Assistant.
data_description.dav1_name: The storage name shown next to its streams.

vyber_zdroju.title: Optional sources
vyber_zdroju.description: Third-party storage services are optional and off by default. Pick only the ones you want to use. For the selected ones the next steps ask for the account. Everything can be changed later in the integration options.

stahovani.title: Downloads and links
stahovani.description: Where downloads land and how notifications and links to your phone are sent.

data.external_host: Address outside the home network (Tailscale/VPN) – for phone links
data.notify_target: Notifications about downloads and new episodes (e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone; empty = HA notification)

data_description.download_dir: A folder on the Home Assistant disk. It must exist and be writable.
data_description.external_host: The address where Home Assistant is reachable from outside the home network (Tailscale, VPN, reverse proxy). Used in links sent to a phone.
data_description.notify_target: A notify service, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone. Empty = notifications stay inside Home Assistant.

synchronizace.title: Sync with Kodi
synchronizace.description: Sharing of watched titles, resume points, My list, Watchlist and search history with the Kodi add-on. There are two routes and both can be used at once: Kodi on the home network connects to Home Assistant directly using the key, Kodi outside the home network goes through a group on the Nokturno dashboard that Home Assistant joins with the code. The data is encrypted with a key derived from the group code and the server cannot read it.

data.sync_key: Key for Kodi on the home network
data.sync_code: Group code (for Kodi outside the home network)

data_description.sync_key: The key for Kodi on the home network; enter it in the add-on under Settings → Synchronisation. It grants access to watched titles and My list, so it belongs only on your own devices.
data_description.sync_code: The group code, NKT-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX. The first Kodi creates it under Settings → Synchronisation → Create group / open for joining. An empty field means Home Assistant stays out of the group and syncs only with Kodi on the home network.
data_description.sync_watched: The watched flag and the resume position in a film or episode. When off, it is neither sent nor received.
data_description.sync_favourites: Titles added to My list in the card and in the add-on.
data_description.sync_watchlist: Series and titles on the Watchlist, including the “keep checking” flag. The check then only needs to run on one device.
data_description.sync_concerts: Files from your own storage stay on this device. Concerts found in the third-party storages you have enabled are shared with the other devices in the group; each device shows only files from the sources it has enabled.

data.tmdb_api_key: TMDB – API key (optional, but takes precedence even over Luna – Czech titles and descriptions)
data.stats_enabled: Send anonymous statistics (when off, only a random id and version are sent)

data_description.tmdb_api_key: Your own key from themoviedb.org. Speeds up loading of titles and plots and removes the dependency on Luna.
data_description.lastfm_key: Key for the list of artists by music genre. Free at last.fm/api. Home Assistant then searches in the background for concerts in your own storage and optionally in the third-party storages you have enabled and set up, and shares them with the group.
data_description.trakt_client_id: Leave empty to use the Nokturno app – then just run the nokturno.trakt_auth service and enter the code on the Trakt website. Works with a free account too. Fill in only if you have your own app.
data_description.stats_enabled: Anonymous usage data – a random id, the version and the titles played. No accounts, addresses or content. When off, only the id and version are sent.

cztor_zdroj.title: CZtor
cztor_zdroj.description: The paid cztor.com catalogue, the device is paired with a PIN.

data_description.cz_enabled: The paid cztor.com catalogue. Turning it on opens a PIN step; the integration never receives the account password.

error.cz_pending: The PIN has not been confirmed yet – enter it at cztor.com/activate and press Submit again.
error.cz_failed: PIN expired or pairing failed – a new PIN is shown, try again.
error.cz_network: CZtor server did not respond. Try again later.
error.sync_code: The group code does not look right – copy it from Kodi, format NKT-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.

search.name: Search
search.description: Searches for a movie or series in the catalogues of the enabled sources (Luna, Sosáč, WebShare) or in the movie database (`catalog` / `catalog_series` – finds titles no source has yet). Returns results as a response.

streams.name: Streams of a title
streams.description: Returns sorted streams for a title from search (id from the Search service).

play.name: Play
play.description: Plays a title in Kodi (through the Nokturno add-on) or another player (direct link). A query can replace the ID – the first found title is played.

query.name: Query
query.description: Movie/series name; used when the ID is missing (voice, scripts).

stream.name: Stream index
stream.description: Index from the Streams service; empty = best by settings.

url.name: Direct link
url.description: Plays this link instead of searching for a stream.

direct.name: Always direct link
direct.description: Even for Kodi use the direct URL instead of the add-on (no watched tracking).

resolve.name: Get link
resolve.description: Returns the direct HTTP URL of a stream – for an external player (VLC, phone) or Cast.

download.name: Download
download.description: Downloads a stream into the HA folder (default /media/nokturno) – then it is available in the Media Browser too.

send_link.name: Send link to phone
send_link.description: Sends a notification with a stream link; tapping it opens the player on the phone.

cancel_download.name: Cancel download
cancel_download.description: Cancels and removes an item from the download queue.

start_download.name: Start queued download
start_download.description: Starts a waiting item right away, alongside what is already downloading.

detail.name: Title detail from the movie database
detail.description: Description, poster, rating and genres of a title by IMDb id (Cinemeta). For titles no source has yet.

id.name: IMDb id
id.description: For example tt41126967 (from a search with type “catalog”).

episodes.name: Series episodes
episodes.description: Returns the list of episodes (and seasons) of a series from search.

delete_file.name: Delete downloaded file
delete_file.description: Deletes a file from the download folder.

continue_watching.name: Continue watching
continue_watching.description: In-progress titles and next episodes from the Nokturno add-on in Kodi.

remove_progress.name: Remove from Continue watching
remove_progress.description: Resets the title's progress on the given Kodi – it disappears from Continue watching without asking; watched status is not affected.

entity_id.name: Kodi
entity_id.description: The Kodi where the title is in progress (same as in the Continue watching item).

file.name: File
file.description: The `file` field of a `continue_watching` item – carries the title id to remove.

watch_series.name: Watch for new episodes
watch_series.description: Adds a series to the Watchlist (new episodes are announced); with `remove` it removes it.

check_series.name: Check for new episodes
check_series.description: Checks series on the Watchlist right away (otherwise every 6 hours).

catalogs.name: Own catalogs status
catalogs.description: Returns the verified own catalogs: how many titles were checked, how many match and when the last check ran.

catalog_verify.name: Verify catalog now
catalog_verify.description: Runs a batch of stream checks for an own catalog right away (without an ID the next catalog in turn). Ignores the pause.

id.name: Catalog ID
id.description: ID of the own catalog (see the Catalogs service). Empty = the next one in turn.

count.name: Number of titles
count.description: How many titles to verify in this batch.

catalog_pause.name: Pause catalog verification
catalog_pause.description: Pauses or resumes the background verification of own catalogs on this Home Assistant.

paused.name: Paused
paused.description: On = the background verification is paused.

clear_history.name: Clear search history
clear_history.description: Clears the recent queries shown in the card.

clear_cache.name: Clear API cache
clear_cache.description: Clears the cache of searches, streams and catalogues (not history or My list) – forces fresh data.

mark_seen.name: Mark new episode as seen
mark_seen.description: Clears the new-episode mark of a series on the Watchlist (without ID: all).

trakt_auth.name: Connect Trakt.tv
trakt_auth.description: Sends a login code as a notification; after entering it at trakt.tv/activate the account is connected.

trakt_watched.name: Trakt – mark as watched
trakt_watched.description: Writes a movie or episode into the Trakt.tv history (with `remove` it removes it).

trakt_watchlist.name: Watchlist – check now
trakt_watchlist.description: Finds which Watchlist titles already have a stream (otherwise runs once a day). The Trakt.tv watchlist is in My list.

trakt_flag.name: Trakt – mark for further checking
trakt_flag.description: Toggles a manual flag on a watchlist item that already has streams but not in the wanted quality/audio (e.g. 5.1) – keeps it visually separate from titles that are simply ready to watch.

id.name: Title ID
id.description: ID as shown in the watchlist item.

share_file.name: Send downloaded file
share_file.description: Creates a temporary link to a downloaded file through the public HA address (Nabu Casa) and sends it to the phone.

notify_service.name: Notification service
notify_service.description: Empty = target from the integration settings.

want_to_watch.name: Watch until available
want_to_watch.description: Adds a title to the Watchlist (checked daily whether it has a stream yet). Without an ID a name is enough – it is watched until the title appears somewhere. With `remove` it removes the item.

id.name: Title ID
id.description: From search results; without it use Name to watch.

query.name: Name to watch
query.description: For titles no source has yet.

series.name: Series ID
series.description: For a saved episode (ID like `tt123:1:3`) – metadata come from it.

favourite_add.name: Move to My list
favourite_add.description: Moves a title from the Watchlist into My list (shared with Kodi) and stops checking it.

id.name: Title ID
id.description: ID as shown on the Watchlist item.

favourite_toggle.name: Add/remove in My list
favourite_toggle.description: Adds a title to My list, or removes it if already saved there – independent of the Watchlist.

fulltext_search.name: Manual full-text search
fulltext_search.description: Searches WebShare, HellSpy, Sledujteto and FastShare with a relaxed filter – finds what regular search discards as a similar but different title. Results are unverified; judgement is left to the user.

source.name: Source
source.description: Where to search – empty searches all enabled sources.

options.first: Play on the first one listed
